overview.zh: Eskom在2025财年的售电量为189.7太瓦时，Eskom自发并送出电量为195,702吉瓦时（扣除抽水电量且不含代输电量）。《综合资源计划2025》在当前基础中列示风电5,344兆瓦和并网太阳能3,646兆瓦；2023年RMIPPPP公告的两个混合可再生能源项目共203兆瓦，采用光伏、陆上风电和储能。
overview.en: Eskom reported 189.7 TWh of sales volumes and 195,702 GWh of Eskom-only energy sent out in FY2025, net of pumping and excluding wheeling. Integrated Resource Plan 2025 lists 5,344 MW of wind and 3,646 MW of grid-tied solar in its current base; a 2023 RMIPPPP announcement covered two hybrid renewable projects totaling 203 MW using solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage.

energyDemand.zh: Eskom在2025财年的售电量为189.7太瓦时，2024财年为183.3太瓦时，同比增长3.5%。Eskom自发并送出电量为195,702吉瓦时，2024财年为184,576吉瓦时；该指标扣除抽水电量且不含代输电量。
energyDemand.en: Eskom sales volumes were 189.7 TWh in FY2025 versus 183.3 TWh in FY2024, a 3.5% increase. Eskom-only energy sent out was 195,702 GWh versus 184,576 GWh; this measure is net of pumping and excluding wheeling.

renewableTarget.zh: 《综合资源计划2025》的平衡方案提出，2026至2042年累计新增太阳能28,713兆瓦、风电43,041兆瓦。这些数值是规划中的累计新增容量，不代表已建成或已采购容量。
renewableTarget.en: The Integrated Resource Plan 2025 balanced plan proposes cumulative additions of 28,713 MW of solar and 43,041 MW of wind for 2026-2042. These are cumulative plan additions, not built or procured capacity.
